SelfTest.Ok: Self-test passed: all required DSA5 and Foundry functions were found.
SelfTest.Missing: Self-test: the following functions are missing or have changed: {missing}. Automation may work only partially.

enabled.Name: Automation enabled
enabled.Hint: Turns the whole NPC automation on or off.

damageApplication.Name: Apply damage automatically
damageApplication.Hint: Applies the damage of a won opposed test to the defender automatically.

advanceTurn.Name: End turn after execution
advanceTurn.Hint: Advances to the next combatant automatically after an NPC turn has been executed.

autoInitiative.Name: Roll initiative automatically
autoInitiative.Hint: Rolls missing initiative for GM-controlled combatants when combat starts and when combatants are added.

defaultSpellRangeSteps.Name: Spell range fallback (yards)
defaultSpellRangeSteps.Hint: Used when the range text of a spell cannot be parsed.

deadTokensBlock.Name: Defeated tokens block movement
deadTokensBlock.Hint: If enabled, spaces occupied by defeated tokens count as blocked for pathfinding.

debug.Name: Debug output
debug.Hint: Writes detailed planning information to the browser console.

focusLimit.Name: Focus limit (attackers per target)
focusLimit.Hint: At most this many automated NPCs attack the same target while other targets are reachable.

archetypeMenu.Name: Archetypes
archetypeMenu.Label: Manage archetypes
archetypeMenu.Hint: Create and edit behaviour presets and assign them to dispositions. Token and actor settings take precedence.

showPathPreview.Name: Path preview on the map
showPathPreview.Hint: Draws the planned path, the target and attack-of-opportunity risks onto the scene while a turn preview is pending.

showOdds.Name: Show odds
showOdds.Hint: Shows the estimated hit chance and expected damage per attack and the success chance per spell in the turn preview.

skipSurrendered.Name: Skip surrendered
skipSurrendered.Hint: Surrendered NPCs lose their turn automatically while others still fight.

surrenderText.Name: Surrender text
surrenderText.Hint: Public chat text for “Post text”; {name} is replaced.

Sheet.Label: Auto Combat – combat role
Sheet.Hazard: Auto Combat – zone on the ground

Warn.provokes: Provokes an attack of opportunity from {names}

Flee.move: Flees {distance} yards away from the nearest enemy
Flee.groupLosses: Group morale broken: {down} of {total} are down

Wait.noPath: no path to the target ({distance} yards)
Wait.holdPosition: holds position ({distance} yards to the target)
Wait.noRetreat: stays in melee ({distance} yards to the target)

Move.encircle: Flanks the target – allies already stand on the other side
Move.block: Cuts off the target's way out

Explain.Maneuver: Maneuver {name} level {step} ({at} AT) – higher expected damage

Constraint.unmet: A GM override could not be applied (weapon/spell not usable)

Hazard.trapped: Stands in {zones} but finds no safe way out

Result.notImplemented: not executable in this version yet

Warn.stale: This turn proposal belongs to a past turn.
Warn.noNpcTurn: The current combatant is not an automatable NPC.
Warn.noCandidates: No further targets available. Target a token to force it.

Config.Title: Auto Combat – {name}
Config.AllowRunning: Running allowed (movement beyond MOV costs an action)
Config.SaveToActor: Also save as default for the actor
Config.ProtegeHint: The token stays with this protégé and attacks whoever attacks them.
Config.SurrenderThresholdHint: 0 = never surrenders. Surrenders instead of fleeing when no escape is open, the enemy outnumbers the group or the leader has fallen.

killer.name: Murderous Brawler
killer.description: Attacks downed targets, never flees, ignores the focus limit and never retreats.

coward.name: Cowardly Thug
coward.description: Picks the weakest target, flees at half its life points and surrenders when escape is impossible or the enemy outnumbers it.

archer.name: Marksman
archer.description: Prefers ranged combat, keeps distance and steps out of melee.

beast.name: Beast
beast.description: Aggressive, no spells, runs after its target even at the cost of an action.

battlemage.name: Battle Mage
battlemage.description: Uses damage spells before weapons and keeps distance.

supportmage.name: Support Mage
supportmage.description: Heals allies early (from 60 % LP), buffs and controls rather than damages.

controller.name: Control Mage
controller.description: Uses control and debuff spells before damage.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Holds position and only attacks what comes into reach.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.description: Stays with its protégé and attacks whoever attacks them (set the protégé on the token).

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: When they fall, their group's morale breaks.

Opportunity.Title: Attack of Opportunity
Opportunity.Text: {target} leaves the melee reach of {attacker}. {attacker} may make an attack of opportunity with {weapon}.
Opportunity.Rule: An attack of opportunity costs no action, suffers −4 on the attack and cannot be defended against.
Opportunity.NotOwner: Only the attacker's owner or the GM may perform this attack of opportunity.

ArchetypeMenu.Title: Auto Combat – Archetypes
ArchetypeMenu.Hint: An archetype bundles behaviour values. “Default” keeps the built-in value. Changes affect every token using the archetype; tokens and actors may override single values.
ArchetypeMenu.ConfirmDelete: Really delete archetype “{name}”? Tokens using it fall back to their disposition default.
ArchetypeMenu.Name: Name

Keys.planTurnHint: Creates an Auto Combat preview for the current combatant.
Keys.executePreviewHint: Executes the pending turn preview of the current combat.

Hazard.Title: Hazard zone: {name}
Hazard.SeverityHint: Avoid: NPCs walk around when the budget allows. Forbidden: acts like a wall.

MagicWall.Busy: A spell wall is already being drawn.
MagicWall.DrawHint: {spell}: click start and end of the wall on the map (right click or Esc cancels).
MagicWall.None: No spell walls on this scene.

Surrender.Title: Surrender
Surrender.Hint: Accept: the token stays “Surrendered”, is skipped and no longer attacked by NPCs. Fights on: remove the condition; the token will not give up again this fight.
Surrender.StatusDescription: Has laid down arms and surrenders.
Surrender.TokenGone: Token no longer on the scene.
Surrender.Attacked: {name} has surrendered and is attacked anyway!
